name: Kaneuri Kichiji
source:
A merchant who serves Fujiwara no Hidehara in Oushuu.
He laid out an information network and gets various information while going around trading.
His more important job is as an "Information Manager".
At necessary times he takes a friendly attitude, but at his core he is a rude person.
By order of Hidehara he escorts the protagonist from Kurama temple to Oushuu.
